description: Execute only the phases of the bound release_mode. surface_setdown executes approach/place, opens and detaches, then executes the checked retreat. container_release executes the single carried place trajectory, stops, verifies actual complete-object bottom and opening footprint, opens and detaches; no automatic retreat or observation follows. Preserve release receipts and invalidate changed spatial geometry before any subsequent planning. verify_place judges the landing separately.  MotionPlanBinding binds target, destination, arm, generation, observation, scene and settings; execution checks it before physical commands.
capability: Execute the bound placement/release mode and retain physical feedback
